artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan union-valuing lean's contract mirror entries, proving the fix by executed merge reconstruction, and recording the duplicated-path audit plus two follow-up candidates

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's extension deploy engine, a path declared by two extensions collides at TWO independent layers, both last-writer-wins with no warning: (1) merge.append_index_entries upserts index entries BY PATH and replaces the WHOLE entry object (no per-field merge), so a later extension's narrower load_when.agents silently discards an earlier one's agent hooks; and (2) copy_category("context", ...) copies context files by path, so an extension whose manifest provides.context lists a shared prefix (e.g. "contracts") overwrites another extension's file at the same deploy path. Consequence: union-valuing load_when.agents on a duplicated path restores the HOOK but not the CONTENT -- the newly-hooked agent then receives the last-deployed extension's domain-specialized override of that file, not the generic core version. Both layers are invisible to check-extension-docs.sh (Rules R and T touch load_when shape and source-file existence, never cross-extension path comparison). Audit for duplicates with: jq -r '.entries[]?.path' over each agent-system/extensions/*/index-entries.json, checking both cross-file collisions and same-file uniq -d internal duplicates.
